sos.title: SOS
sos.disclaimer: This app supplements calling emergency services. It never replaces it.

geofence.notAnEmergencyLabel: SAFE ZONE ALERT · not an emergency
geofence.graceHint: A short grace period avoids a false alert from GPS drift at the edge of the zone.

watch.neverAlertsAlone: A watch tap never sends an alert by itself.

weeklySummary.title: Weekly summary
weeklySummary.disclaimer: Numbers only, never advice: this reports what happened, not what to do about it.

notes.title: Care notes
notes.visibilityNotice: Everyone with access to {{patientName}} will see this. It is not a medical record — conditions, allergies and medications are still edited on their own screens.

android.title: Android setup checklist
android.item0: Notifications allowed, including full-screen alerts and DND override for the SOS channel
android.item2: Battery: Unrestricted; remove from "sleeping" or "optimized" lists (Samsung: "Never auto sleeping apps")
android.item3: Brand-specific steps where needed (Xiaomi, Oppo, Vivo, Realme, Infinix have extra auto-start and background limits)
android.item4: SOS widget on the home screen
android.item5: Recommend turning on the phone's built-in Emergency SOS as a separate backup
android.item6: Turn on automatic app updates in Google Play
android.item7: Pair a Wear OS watch for SOS from the wrist, if the Primary has one
android.item8: Turn on voice commands and Bluetooth hearing-aid audio streaming, if wanted

iphone.title: iPhone setup checklist
iphone.item0: Notifications allowed; Critical Alerts allowed (once approved); Time Sensitive allowed
iphone.item3: Add the app to Focus-mode allow-lists; set the Primary as an Emergency Bypass contact in Contacts
iphone.item4: SOS widget and Control Center control added
iphone.item5: Turn on automatic app updates in the App Store
iphone.item6: Pair an Apple Watch for SOS from the wrist, if the Primary has one
iphone.item7: Turn on voice commands and Made-for-iPhone hearing-aid audio streaming, if wanted
